capabilities: Place, move, resize and delete editable text boxes on PDF pages
Write notes into the PDF file as real searchable page text
Format box text with colours, superscript, subscript and a symbol palette
Keep an untouched original of each PDF and restore it on demand
Move or trash notes when the PDF is renamed or deleted
extras: Not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Desktop only (macOS, Windows, Linux); notes show read-only on mobile. Refuses signed or encrypted PDFs and warns on fillable forms. No network access. Install via zip or BRAT. Data is stored in a hidden folder that Obsidian Sync skips unless relocated.
intentEvidence: Works on top of Obsidian's own PDF viewer: search, outline, zoom and links stay as they are
problem: Obsidian's built-in PDF viewer lets you read PDFs but offers no way to type your own notes onto the pages in a form other apps and tools can read.
summary: PDF annotation plugin that places editable text boxes on PDFs in Obsidian's viewer and writes the notes into the PDF as real, searchable page text.
